note: Per-clip exposure bands for the dual-venue visual gate (VISUAL-GATE-EXPOSURE-FLOOR-1). clips maps a clip id to { minMedianLuma, maxMedianLuma (0..255), maxNearBlackFraction, maxClippedFraction (0..1) }, judged against the MEDIAN over a leg's judged play frames; a field a row leaves out takes the absolute fallback's value. A clip with no row (every clip today: rows are seeded from the grade corpus by VISUAL-GATE-EXPOSURE-BANDS-SEED-1) is judged against the fallback band in DualVenueRunner.psm1: median luma >= 16, near-black fraction <= 0.60, clipped fraction <= 0.05. A missing, empty or malformed file (or a malformed row anywhere in it) falls back the same way and is reported in the receipt; a row carries only the four caps.
